sources.act: Value-Added Tax Act (부가가치세법), English and Korean text at the Korea Legislation Research Institute, https://elaw.klri.re.kr/kor_service/lawViewMultiContent.do?hseq=40928 (wholly amended by Act No. 11873, Jun. 7, 2013; last amendment shown Act No. 14387, Dec. 20, 2016); the current Korean text at https://www.law.go.kr/법령/부가가치세법 shows enforcement 2026-01-02 (Act No. 21065)
sources.rate: Article 30: 'The tax rate of value-added tax shall be 10 percent.' (부가가치세의 세율은 10퍼센트로 한다.)
sources.export: Article 21 (1): the supply of goods that falls within exportation qualifies for the tax rate of zero percent
sources.exempt: Article 26 (1): the supply of the goods or services listed is exempt from value-added tax
sources.reverse_charge: Article 52 (1): a person receiving services from a non-resident or foreign corporation without a domestic place of business collects VAT when paying, excluding services delivered to a taxable business, including services whose input tax is not deductible under Article 39
sources.rate_from: 2013-06-07 is the date of the wholly amended Act read; earlier periods were not read
sources.not_confirmed: The business registration number's check digit is not described by the Act read: the number is checked for its shape (10 digits) only. The return's layout is ERP's own sums, not the National Tax Service form's numbering.

number_hint: a 10-digit business registration number (its shape is checked, not its check digit)
export_reason: Export: VAT at 0% (Value-Added Tax Act, article 21)
exempt_reason: Exempt from VAT (Value-Added Tax Act, article 26)
